ctx.x: That’s a good talking point about what people think about when they’re improvising. Are you a chordal oriented person? I mean did you have theory on the way up so that you know what all those chord changes mean?

Yes. I had music theory. I did it in the classroom from a quote unquote technical point of view and then made it practical. I thought about well this chord goes, these are the notes that go with this chord, the C seven, C-E-G-B flat. And if I wanted to put the nine on it I could do this. And then I went through the stage of practicing patterns that would go with certain chords.
